purpose: Teach: 戰/燈/會/茵/繭/狭間/のっとっ/云い

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、旧字「戰」、つまり戦時遺品の鑑定を、警察、専門家に依頼されますね
lines.en: In this case, you'll be requesting that the police consult with specialists to authenticate the wartime artifacts, won't you?
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal opening. Thoughtful pause after the rhetorical question mark. Soft, considering tone — not challenging but genuinely curious about procedure. Even delivery, no rush.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧字「燈」、つまり灯油盗難の事案も対応されますね
lines.en: And the police will also be handling the kerosene theft cases that come up, I imagine.
lines.style: Calm acknowledgment. Slight nod in the voice — accepting the premise. Professional warmth. Delivers as collaborative confirmation rather than defensive statement. Steady eye-level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、旧字「會」、つまり會社の偽装登記を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: And in this matter, the police will be investigating the fraudulent business registrations as well, correct?
lines.style: Continuing the same reflective, procedural tone. Gentle lean forward. Each case presented as natural extension of the last. Curiosity without pressure. Soft landing on the final particle.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場の茵、つまり茵席の繊維分析もされますね
lines.en: Yes, and the police will also be conducting fiber analysis on the upholstery collected from the scene.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Brief, honest. No elaboration needed — he's simply stating what happens next in the chain. Reliable tone. Slight shift to more factual register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、密輸の繭、つまり繭製品の捜査を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: And the investigation into the smuggled silk cocoon products — the police will be moving forward with that as well?
lines.style: Same reflective quality maintained throughout. Thoughtful pacing. The questions feel genuinely exploratory rather than performative. Slight curiosity inflection at the end. Patient listening voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、山の狭間の遭難事案を、警察、救助されますね
lines.en: We'll also be coordinating the search and rescue efforts for the missing person in the mountain pass, naturally.
lines.style: Factual, direct. No doubt in the statement. Professional confidence. Brief but complete. The kind of answer that settles the matter without needing restatement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、法令にのっとっ、つまり則って捜査されますね
lines.en: And throughout all of this, the police will be proceeding strictly in accordance with the law, won't they?
lines.style: Slight shift toward weightier tone. The question lands with quiet importance. Not accusatory, but definitely checking something matters. Careful delivery on the final clause. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の云い、つまり「云い分」を、警察、丁寧に聴かれますね
lines.en: Of course — and we'll be listening carefully to the suspects' statements and their side of things.
lines.style: Direct and sincere. No hesitation. This one lands as genuine reassurance, not procedural confirmation. Slight warmth underneath the formality. The closing carries personal commitment, not just protocol.
